mentions.name: Llama vs Alpaca
mentions.description: This is a Peruvian specialty coffee and cacao shop in Munich, run together with the author's wife, inviting people to visit and chat.
mentions.source_excerpt: Together with my wife we opened a Peruvian specialty coffee and cacao shop in Munich, it's called Llama vs Alpaca. Feel free to come by and chat!
mentions.author: tardenoisean
